storyTitle: Admin – Team Ranking page (opened from Manage Registrations)

testCases.description: Verify: ### 1. Opening the page
Verify state persists after navigation away and back
Verify: Both **created** and **registered** teams are listed.
Verify: On opening, "All divisions" is selected and every division with teams is shown.
Verify: Ranked teams appear first in rank order
Verify: unranked teams appear below them.
Verify: Each division heading shows how many teams are ranked, e.g. "3 of 5 ranked".
Verify: Division headings stay visible while scrolling through that division's teams.
Verify: Each division can be collapsed and expanded by clicking its heading.
Verify: ### 2. Filtering
Verify: Clicking "All divisions" clears any specific selection.
Verify: The admin can select one or several divisions at once
Verify: only those divisions are shown.
Verify: Selecting every individual division is treated as "All divisions".
Verify: The search box filters teams by name as the admin types, not case-sensitive.
Verify: Filters and search only change what is visible
Verify: they never change any rank.
Verify: If nothing matches, show "No teams match. Adjust the division or search filters."
Verify: ### 3. Setting a rank by typing
Verify: Admin types a whole number and presses Enter or clicks away.
Verify: Pressing Enter moves the cursor to the next team's rank box.
Verify: If the rank is already used by another team in the same division, the team takes that position and teams below it move d
Verify: Clearing the box makes the team unranked.
Verify: Ranks are independent per division (two divisions can each have a rank 1).
Verify: ### 4. Drag and drop and arrows
Verify: Admin can drag a team onto another team in the same division. Dropping into a different division is not allowed.
Verify: Up/down arrows move a team one position.
Verify: After any move, ranks in that division renumber automatically (1, 2, 3...) with no gaps.
Verify: The top team cannot move up
Verify: the bottom team cannot move down.
Verify: Moving an unranked team into the ranked area makes it ranked.
Verify: ### 5. Auto-assign toggle for new teams
Verify: Toggle is **off** by default.
Verify: When **on**, a newly added team is ranked automatically in its own division:
Verify: **Add at bottom:** next number after the highest rank in that division.
Verify: **Add at top:** rank 1, and all other ranked teams in that division move down by one.
Verify: When **off**, the new team appears in its division with no rank.
Verify: An auto-ranked team shows a small **Auto** tag until the admin saves.
Verify: A confirmation message appears, e.g. "Cedar Vipers added to U14 Boys with rank 4."
Verify: ### 6. Clear ranks
Verify: Clears ranks only for teams currently visible under the chosen division filters and search.
Verify: Shows how many were cleared, e.g. "Cleared 5 ranks", with an **Undo** link.
Verify: ### 7. Undo
Verify: Every change (typing a rank, moving, clearing, adding an auto-ranked team, discarding) shows a message with an **Undo**
Verify: Undo steps back through up to 30 earlier changes in the current session.
Verify: ### 8. Saving and discarding
Verify: The unsaved changes bar appears as soon as anything differs from the last saved state and shows the number of teams chan
Verify: **Save rankings** stores ranks for all teams, shows "Rankings saved", hides the bar and removes Auto tags.
Verify: **Discard** returns everything to the last saved state and can itself be undone.
Verify: Saving is blocked if any division has two teams with the same rank, naming the divisions.
Verify: ### 9. Entry point
Verify: The **Ranking** button appears on the **Manage Registrations** and **Tournament Manage** screen for admins only and open
Verify: ### 10. Create Pool – Use Ranking
Verify: In **Create Pool**, the existing **Auto Generate Pool** functionality remains available.
Verify: A checkbox labeled **"Use ranking to add teams to pools"** is displayed with the existing **Number of teams per pool** i
Verify: The checkbox is **unchecked by default**.
Verify: When the checkbox is unchecked, clicking **Auto Generate Pool** follows the existing pool-generation workflow and does n
Verify: When the checkbox is selected, clicking **Auto Generate Pool** uses the saved rankings of teams in the selected division
Verify: The **Number of teams per pool** value determines how many teams are required in each generated pool.
Verify: Ranked teams are considered in rank order, starting with rank 1.
Verify: Ranked teams are selected before unranked teams.
Verify: The selected ranked teams are distributed into pools using the existing pool distribution logic.
Verify: Team rankings are not changed when pools are generated.
Verify: Generating pools does not assign ranks to previously unranked teams.
Verify: ### 11. Create Pool – Ranked and unranked teams
Verify: If all teams in the selected division are ranked, the system selects teams according to their rank until the required po
Verify: If some teams are ranked and some are unranked, all applicable ranked teams are considered first in rank order.
Verify: If the ranked teams do not provide enough teams to fill the required pool positions, the remaining positions are filled
Verify: Unranked teams are not assigned an artificial rank during pool generation.
Verify: If there are not enough total teams to fill the configured pool positions, the existing behavior for insufficient teams
Verify: ### 12. Create Pool – Division handling
Verify: Rankings are considered only within the division selected in **Create Pool**.
Verify: A team's rank in one division has no effect on teams in another division.
Verify: Rank 1 in one division and rank 1 in another division are treated independently.
Verify: If **All divisions** or multiple divisions are supported by the existing Create Pool flow, ranking is evaluated separate
Verify: Teams from different divisions are not mixed as a result of ranking-based selection unless the existing pool-generation
Verify: ### 13. Create Pool – Saved ranking requirement
Verify: If the admin changes rankings but has not saved them, the unsaved ranking changes are not used by **Auto Generate Pool**
Verify: The system uses the last saved ranking state when generating pools.
Verify: After rankings are saved, the updated rankings are available for the next ranking-based pool generation.
